summary: Short kerb on a college street; student dormitories about 21 m across the road.
reasons: College street, cars park opposite side
Treed verge and private car park behind

drivers.seclusion: Treed verge and a private college car park on the kerb side. Dormitories lie 21 m away across the road and 31 m beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed two-way road; no parked cars on the east kerb, so room to pull in is uncertain. A mapped lift gate sits 5 m away, with a way round.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the west side only; no parking convention on the east kerb.

flags: Mapped lift gate 5 m away, not on the only access
Union College parking behind is private
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the east kerb shades it from the afternoon sun.
cannot_judge: Whether the kerb is wide enough to stop clear of the lane

best_section.where: East kerb of the college access road, just south of the lift gate
